Orlando Health Cardiovascular Events
Remember to Join Us this Thursday
Thank you again for registering for our lecture this Heart Disease and Women: Dispelling Myths. As a reminder the lecture will be held this Thursday, March 5, from 6:00-7:00 pm, at the Renaissance Senior Center (3800 South Econlockhatchee Trail, Orlando, FL 32829). Please look for directional signage to help guide you in. Parking is available at the front of the center.
Please remember to bring a light jacket, as the room may be a bit cold. Lastly, light refreshments will be served.
To view the complete listing of lectures, visit OrlandoHealth.com/heartevents.
